title: Secret Screening of ‘Gremlins’ Reveals Assembly Cut of 1980s Classic for First Time Since 1983 (Exclusive)
summary: And it brought out a who's who of horror players, among them 'Final Destination: Bloodlines' filmmakers (and 'Gremlins 3' writers) Adam B. Stein and Zach Lipovsky, Drew Hancock ('Companion'), Rob Savage ('The Boogeyman'), Brian Duffield ('Whalefall'), and Akela Cooper ('M3GAN').
